title: Synthetic F210-only installation guidance omission

steps: Select the preserved MIR 4.0.0 F210 distribution record.
Render the synthetic target-specific installation guidance.
Inspect the synthetic upgrade sentence required only by F210.
reproducer.expected: The F210 package guidance contains the target-specific upgrade sentence.
reproducer.actual: The synthetic F210 guidance omits the target-specific upgrade sentence.

target_dispositions.reason: The synthetic omission is declared only for the F210 installation surface.
The F200 installation surface does not require the synthetic F210 sentence.
The F110 installation surface does not require the synthetic F210 sentence.
The F100 installation surface does not require the synthetic F210 sentence.

regression_proposition: For the same accepted change inventory, only the F210 installation view gains the required synthetic sentence and every other target remains byte-identical.
